cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.
Хвала is the direct object of the transitive verb поете (sing), taking accusative case.
The verb вознесите with a dative object indicates the recipient of the raised cry.

cases.sentence: Как грозен Господь Всевышний, великий ___ над всей землей
cases.explain: Царь is the subject complement after the verb быть (to be), taking nominative case.
The preposition над (over/above) governs the instrumental case.
The noun звуки (sounds) takes a genitive modifier to show possession: 'sounds of horns.'
The noun вожди (leaders) takes a genitive modifier to indicate possession: 'leaders of the people.'
Наследие is the direct object of the transitive verb избрал (chose), taking accusative case.

reading.ru: Как грозен Господь Всевышний, великий Царь над всей землей
reading.question: How is God described in this verse?
options: Awesome and a great King over all the earth
Weak and distant from the earth
reading.correct: Awesome and a great King over all the earth
reading.explain: The text explicitly describes God as грозен (awesome) and великий Царь над всей землей (great King over all the earth).

reading.ru: Рукоплещите все народы, вознесите Богу крик радости
reading.question: What are all the peoples called to do?
options: Clap their hands and raise a cry of joy to God
reading.correct: Clap their hands and raise a cry of joy to God
reading.explain: The text commands: Рукоплещите все народы (all peoples clap), вознесите Богу крик радости (raise a cry of joy to God).

reading.ru: Он покорил нам народы, бросил нам под ноги племена
reading.question: What has God done for the people according to this passage?
options: He has subdued nations and put peoples under their feet
He has taken away their power
He has scattered them among enemies
He has hidden himself from them
reading.correct: He has subdued nations and put peoples under their feet
reading.explain: Он покорил нам народы, бросил нам под ноги племена — He subjected nations to them and cast tribes beneath their feet.

reading.ru: Бог вознесся под крики радости, Господь вознесся под звуки рогов
reading.question: What accompanied God's exaltation?
options: Cries of joy and the sound of trumpets
reading.correct: Cries of joy and the sound of trumpets
reading.explain: The verse states that God's ascent was accompanied by крики радости (cries of joy) and звуки рогов (sounds of horns/trumpets).

reading.ru: Бог, царь над всей землей, поете ему искусный псалом
reading.question: What should be sung to God?
reading.explain: The text commands: поете ему искусный псалом (sing to him a skillful/wise psalm).

reading.ru: земные правители принадлежат Богу, Он высоко превознесся
reading.question: To whom do the rulers of the earth belong?
options: To God, who is highly exalted
To the people who serve them
reading.correct: To God, who is highly exalted
reading.explain: The text states: земные правители принадлежат Богу (the rulers of the earth belong to God), Он высоко превознесся (He is highly exalted).
